title: Old-ST Service Generator
description: Scaffold a NestJS HTTP API microservice (skeleton). Use the `domain` generator to scaffold a full domain + service together.

domain.description: Domain name in kebab-case (e.g. shipping). The service will live at apps/{domain}/{domain}-api-service.
domain.x-prompt: What is the domain name (kebab-case, e.g. shipping)?

entity.description: Entity name in kebab-case singular (default: same as domain). Drives the module/controller/app-service file names.

persistence.description: Persistence layer (dynamodb only for now — prisma support to come).

publishesEvents.description: If true, the service publishes domain events to SQS. Adds {DOMAIN}_SQS_QUEUE_URL/_NAME env vars and registers the queue URL in service-registry.json.
